quarantine_manifest.actual_provider: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra (free tier) via OpenRouter
quarantine_manifest.provider_change_rationale_at_time: ZAI API rate-limited (HTTP 429). CEO directive at the time instructed use of OpenRouter.
quarantine_manifest.provider_change_audit_verdict: INVALID per Amendment 14. Changing provider after protocol freeze creates a NEW EXPERIMENT, not a continuation of DXP-005. The A/B/C ablation comparison is valid within Nemotron, but cannot inherit the DXP-005 preregistered status.

conditions_with_zero_hypotheses: N4/A-baseline (0 hyps — LLM returned empty response)

why_n4_is_unusable_for_ablation.issue: N4-A returned 0 hypotheses (LLM empty response). N4-B and N4-C returned 3 hypotheses each. The apparent B-vs-A advantage is confounded: A = provider/output failure, B = successful generation. This is NOT necessarily A = baseline cognition vs B = mechanism-constrained cognition.
why_n4_is_unusable_for_ablation.verdict: N4 cannot contribute to the primary A/B/C efficacy comparison.

why_n1_n3_transfer_rejection_is_not_a_sc.issue: TRANSFER_REJECTED is an observed output, not CORRECT_NEGATIVE. Adjudication requires: (1) valid input, (2) valid extraction, (3) valid abstraction, (4) rejection caused by intended criterion, (5) equivalent upstream artifacts across conditions, (6) rejection not a provider failure, (7) independent adjudication against ground truth.
why_n1_n3_transfer_rejection_is_not_a_sc.verdict: None of these 7 conditions have been independently verified. The rejections are observed outputs only.

what_may_be_salvaged_from_this_pilot.observation_1: N4-B produced specific mechanisms with quantitative predictions (15% biaxial strain, 330nm lattice constant). N4-C produced hypotheses referencing the null graph's generic labels (generic_mechanism_9, generic_process_6). This suggests the mechanism-null condition has an observable effect on hypothesis content.
what_may_be_salvaged_from_this_pilot.observation_2: This observation is NOT evidence for H-GEN-1. It is a sanity-check signal that the null condition alters output. Whether this produces a statistically significant mechanism-specific advantage requires the full preregistered sample under the preregistered provider.
what_may_be_salvaged_from_this_pilot.potential_future_use: This pilot may become the basis for a separately preregistered Nemotron experiment (e.g., DXP-005b-NEMOTRON) with its own protocol freeze. It CANNOT be used to support or falsify H-GEN-1 under the original DXP-005 protocol.

what_must_not_be_done_with_this_pilot: Do not merge Nemotron results into DXP-005 primary analysis.
Do not label H-GEN-1 as supported or falsified based on these results.
Do not interpret N4-B vs N4-A difference as ablation evidence.
Do not interpret N1/N2/N3 transfer rejection as CORRECT_NEGATIVE without adjudication.
Do not use these results in any capability claim.
Do not destroy these artifacts — they are preserved as exploratory evidence.

artifact_locations.runner_scripts: scripts/run_dxp005*.py, scripts/run_dxp005_all.sh (also moved here for archival; copies remain in scripts/ for reference but should not be re-executed under DXP-005 protocol)

quarantine_manifest.quarantine_reason_reference: External audit finding: provider substitution after protocol freeze violates Amendment 14 (Scientific Visibility Boundary).
